data.name: MainWindow_Subtitle
data.value: Analysis, gentle processing and export with FFmpeg

data.name: Hint_DropFileOrSelect
data.value: or use the button to select one

data.name: Footer_Disclaimer
data.value: Original files are never overwritten. Stream copy picks a compatible container; otherwise the chosen parameters are used for export.

data.name: Status_SelectPresetAndFormat
data.value: Please choose a preset and an export format.

data.name: Log_TwoPassMeasurementsFailed
data.value: Two-pass loudness could not be evaluated. Processing continues with the safe single-pass filter.

data.name: Log_ArchiveForcesFlac
data.value: Archive export forces FLAC so that the result is stored losslessly.

data.name: Error_FFmpegNotFound
data.value: FFmpeg was not found. Install FFmpeg and make sure ffmpeg.exe is on PATH or next to the app.

data.name: Error_FFprobeNotFound
data.value: FFprobe was not found. Install FFmpeg and make sure ffprobe.exe is on PATH or next to the app.

data.name: Error_FFmpegExitCodeFormat
data.value: FFmpeg exited with code {0}. Details are in the log.

data.name: Error_FFmpegStartFailed
data.value: An unexpected error occurred while starting FFmpeg.

data.name: Error_FileNotFound
data.value: The selected file does not exist.

data.name: Error_SourceFileNotFound
data.value: The source file was not found.

data.name: Error_UnsupportedFormat
data.value: This file format is not supported. Supported formats are mp3, wav, flac, m4a, aac, ogg, opus, mp4 and mkv.

data.name: Error_UnsupportedFormatShort
data.value: This file format is not supported.

data.name: Error_FFprobeAnalysisFailed
data.value: FFprobe could not analyze the file. Check that the file contains a readable audio stream.

data.name: Error_FFprobeNoData
data.value: FFprobe did not return any analysis data.

data.name: Error_NoAudioStream
data.value: No audio stream was found in the file.

data.name: Error_FFprobeDataUnreadable
data.value: FFprobe data could not be read.

data.name: Error_AnalysisFailed
data.value: An unexpected error occurred during analysis.

data.name: Error_SourceAnalysisFailed
data.value: The source could not be analyzed.

data.name: Error_TargetExists
data.value: The target file already exists. Please start processing again.

data.name: Error_SaveFailed
data.value: The output file could not be saved after processing.

data.name: Error_StreamCopyNotPossible
data.value: This audio stream cannot be reliably extracted without re-encoding. Choose an export format like FLAC or WAV instead.

data.name: Error_PreviewFileNotFound
data.value: The preview file was not found.

data.name: Error_PreviewOpenFailed
data.value: The file could not be opened for preview. The Windows playback system may not support this format.

data.name: Error_PreviewFailedGeneric
data.value: Preview failed: the Windows playback system does not support this format.

data.name: Error_ToolNotFoundFormat
data.value: {0}.exe was not found. Install FFmpeg or place ffmpeg.exe and ffprobe.exe next to the app or inside the Tools folder.

data.name: Filter_NoFilters
data.value: No audio filters. The track is only exported to the chosen target format.

data.name: Quality_GeneralNote
data.value: This tool can enhance, normalize and restore audio, but it cannot recover information that was already destroyed by bad recording or lossy compression.

data.name: Quality_LosslessTarget
data.value: A lossless target format avoids additional export loss but does not make a lossy source better than it is.

data.name: Warning_LossySource
data.value: The source is already lossy. Processing can improve sound, loudness and intelligibility but cannot fully restore lost details.

data.name: Preset_Music_Description
data.value: Loudness normalization around -14 LUFS with a -1.5 dB true peak limit.

data.name: Preset_Music_QualityNote
data.value: For music, aggressive noise reduction is intentionally not enabled so that dynamics and tonal character are preserved.

data.name: Preset_Speech_Description
data.value: High-pass at 80 Hz, normalization around -16 LUFS and optional subtle speech processing.

data.name: Preset_Speech_QualityNote
data.value: For speech, intelligibility and loudness are prioritized. Compression and presence boost are intentionally moderate.

data.name: Preset_Noise_Description
data.value: Reduces background noise with afftdn. The strength is adjustable.

data.name: Preset_Noise_QualityNote
data.value: Too much noise reduction can sound metallic or artificial. Start conservative and check the result.

data.name: Preset_Copy_Description
data.value: Extracts the first audio stream without filters and without re-encoding, when the codec is sensibly copyable.

data.name: Preset_Copy_QualityNote
data.value: This option does not improve sound, but it avoids additional quality loss.

data.name: Preset_Archive_Description
data.value: Saves the processed audio track as FLAC.

data.name: Preset_Archive_QualityNote
data.value: FLAC is lossless but does not restore details that were already lost.

data.name: Preset_Everyday_Description
data.value: Exports to an everyday format with good quality at a sensible file size.

data.name: Preset_Everyday_QualityNote
data.value: For everyday exports, AAC 256k, MP3 320k or Opus 160k/192k are good choices.

data.name: ExportFormat_Wav24_Description
data.value: Uncompressed PCM at 24 bit. Very large but lossless after processing.

data.name: ExportFormat_Flac_Description
data.value: Lossless compression. Useful for archiving after processing.

data.name: ExportFormat_Premiere_Description
data.value: For video editing: WAV 24 bit at 48 kHz. Lossless after processing and compatible with Adobe Premiere Pro.

data.name: ExportFormat_Aac_Description
data.value: Good quality at a moderate file size.

data.name: ExportFormat_Opus160_Description
data.value: Efficient codec for small files at good quality.

data.name: ExportFormat_Opus192_Description
data.value: Efficient codec with more headroom for complex material.
